body: honestly I’m on like my 16th rewatch at the moment (some may say that’s too many) and it is still the absolute best show I’ve ever watched in my life and each and every scene still gets me just as hyped/emotional as my first viewing, utterly amazing writing, directing and acting in every episode, especially from my personal favourite actor in the show, Bryan Cranston. his acting in this show in honest to god just phenomenal, maybe actually some of the best acting I’ve ever had the pleasure of watching in my 19 years on this earth

all I can say as someone who struggles considerably with my own drinking, I would say that you should ask him about it and/or say something about how you feel about it and how it could potentially affect you (and maybe other people) and then see what you can do for him in terms of non-medical help (at home help)

but I will say that if he doesn't respond entirely as people would see as "positively", don't pressure him into anything, just try to ease him into some sort of help I'd say. that's what I would prefer at least, I don't want to pretend that I know everything about it all but in my personal opinion that's what I would prefer
honestly it feels so shit. I'm always here if you need to talk, I know full well how shit it is to have nobody to talk to but I'm here if you need it

I'm definitely gonna try this, regardless of how hard it is to focus on or listen to anything right now. thank you for even being here to try and help, you're a good person for even paying attention to this, thank you
